name: Eons: Dark Hound
source:
Sometimes to move forward, the key is in the past. 
The Dark Hound is freed from its seal and out killing again. It is infallible, but the past may hold hints to its weaknesses...

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/centridus/art/VN-Eons-Dark-Hound-v0-83a-309951341] Deviantart[/url]]
